entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet, but I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, um, a preference, I think? The color just doesn't look like it did online. I haven't even touched it, the box is still unopened. I'm just... I find the policies so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I just need to look up your order to check the details. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, let me find it... it's VF-8675309.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 17 days ago.
Let me just check the policy here... and yes, it looks like you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery for standard items.
Oh, really? That's it? I was so worried I missed a deadline or something. That's a huge relief.

Not at all, you're well within the timeframe. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print that out, tape it to the original box, and you can drop it off. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process your full refund.
That's wonderful! Thank you so much, David. You made that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
